name: theme-scope
title: Theme Scope
description: Applies a Syntara theme, colour scheme and density to everything inside it.

props.name: theme
props.description: Tenant id whose tokens are loaded under [data-syntara-theme]. Omit to inherit the page theme.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale, e.g. "ar-AE". Sets React Aria's locale (arrow-key direction, date formats, placement) and, unless given, lang and dir. Right-to-left regions need it.

notes: Pass locale for other-language or right-to-left regions: React Aria reads direction from the locale, not the DOM dir attribute.
Overlays opened inside the scope copy its theme, scheme, density, dir and lang when they open.

do: Put the theme, scheme and density attributes on one element — token CSS needs them together.
dont: Don't nest scopes with different schemes inside inline text; scope whole regions.
